requests.prompt:
ORTHOGRAPHIC VERTICAL OVERHEAD PLAN VIEW. Camera directly above, looking straight down at the object's TOP SURFACE ONLY. Rectangular edges run horizontally and vertically on the canvas. Show no vertical front or side faces.

Create an ORIGINAL, redesigned Phobos spacecraft chemical-machine sprite, in the working-spacer visual language of Ostranauts, imagined in 2075. Reference Image 1 is approved original Phobos artwork: use its coherent mechanical detail, crisp recessed components, chipped enamel, ceramic/metal material separation and strictly vertical overhead camera. Reference Image 2 is the old original Phobos sprite of THIS machine: retain its maker's established colours and useful functional landmarks, but improve the machinery design substantially. Do not copy Oxsmith's red palette, electrode layout or lettering.

Square high-resolution canvas, preferably 1536 x 1536 or larger and at least 1024 x 1024. Continuous opaque square machine deck reaches all four canvas edges and fills every corner. NO margin, floor, backdrop or transparent gaps. Back and power connection edge at TOP; crew service edge at BOTTOM. Every fitting and internal pipe stays within the square. Any external gas, water or conveyor connections are separate game objects.

Machine: Phobos' Fennmark V4 Volatiles Refinery, four by four floor tiles, native 64 x 64 pixels.
Maker palette: graphite enamel perimeter frame, restrained burnt-orange corner clamps and latch handles, pale sand refractory deck plates, blackened steel working vessels, a few dull copper bands. This is Fennmark, visibly different from oxide-red Oxsmith.

The V4 is a sealed electric hearth and drying/refining retort that cooks mined rock, dries materials and recovers gases. Draw its TOP as a strong circular charcoal hearth lid in the UPPER LEFT, with a heavy ring of bolts, an orange locking boss and a pale refractory collar. No electrode caps or electrical busbars on the lid. At UPPER RIGHT, a long rectangular strapped retort lid running vertically, with two heavy steel ribs, orange latch ends and a short copper manifold leading to a compact condensation/cooling module. At LOWER LEFT, a squared feed hatch with a broad recessed burnt-orange handle. At LOWER RIGHT, an empty wide dark residue/casting collection recess beside a coarse cooling grille. Broad quiet sand deck regions between the assemblies. Four heavy clamps integrated into the graphite frame. These shapes must remain clear at 64 x 64.
Style: convincing practical industrial spaceship equipment rather than a simple flat schematic icon. Use a few dominant working assemblies, sturdy clamps, dark recesses, purposeful broad panel seams and restrained wear at fasteners. Deliberate chunky PIXEL ART: stepped edges, readable square pixel clusters, mostly flat material colours with two or three shade steps, crisp dark mechanical outlines, restrained highlights. Keep the same artistic quality as the first reference, scaled to the native pixel density specified above. No smooth gradients, dithering, excessive tiny greebles, polished reflections, dramatic lighting or product photography.

All permanent hatches are closed, product trays empty. No consumable workpieces, liquid level strip, glowing sight port, hot glow or painted working-state effects. No text, letters, numbers, logos, symbols, hazard decals, screens, dials, gauges, lamps, indicator lights or live-state instruments. No people, ground shadows, beams, floor or surrounding scene. No isometric view, tilted/diamond footprint, perspective, front/side walls or rendered height. Only top surfaces, unrotated square footprint.
requests.review: Overhead Fennmark pilot checked at 64 x 64 before the X2/K2 family expansion. Graphite/orange frame, sealed hearth, strapped retort and residue/mould recesses remain distinct. Full opaque square, correct overhead, no text or painted live instruments. Existing footprint and runtime identity preserved.
